source._comment: WIRED 2026-10-16: Texas SoS 'Election Information & Turnout Data' app (goelect.txelections.civixapps.com/ivis-evr-ui/evr), JSON endpoints getFile?type=EVR_ELECTION and getFile?type=EVR_EARLYVOTING&electionId=&electionDate= (base64 JSON): all 254 counties with registered voters, cumulative in-person early votes and mail ballots received. Unofficial, as submitted by counties. Texas has no party registration -> turnout-only.

live_arcgis._comment: Counties whose own vote-center map carries each site's votes (read like the ElectionLink widgets: in-person early votes through the day, used where ahead of the SoS). Dallas: the 'Vote Center Finder 3.0' ArcGIS Experience linked from dallascountyvotes.org (owner dallascountygis); layer Vote_Centers_20261103, one row per site, L_Poll_Typ EV/ED, C_Daily_Tot = today's votes, C_Tot_Vts = running total (equal on day 1, 10/19: 84 EV sites, 50,435 at 3:21 PM CT). Election Day rows are not read yet.

party_history._comment: theoelections.com (a third-party Texas elections site, GitHub Pages; robots allow all; no stated reuse terms) publishes per-county early voters split by the last party primary each voted in (2020-2026), from the counties' early-voting rosters matched to primary history: data/early/past/<SoS election id>.json(.gz), the file behind theoelections.com/early-vote ('by primary voter'). Used unaltered with attribution for the all-ballots party split (Sam asked 2026-10-19). Fields per county: voters, dem, rep, both, none (by day; the last non-null day is used); counties whose parts don't add up are skipped. Its hourly feed (data/live/hourly.json) covers the same ElectionLink counties we read directly plus Dallas's map (read directly via live_arcgis).
